**Big but shallow: 1291 hits, 94 files.** About 1075 are internal names, safe to rename.

| must not rename | hits | why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` and the right side of `WIRE` in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 6 | public contract, breaking change |
| SQL strings in 25 `repo/*.js` | 125 | real column name |
| `migrations/` | 61 | applied history, breaks down steps |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | wiped by `npm run vendor:refresh` |

All 25 inserts also write `account_id` into the JSONB `payload`. Renaming there splits old rows from new.

Next: sign off on internals only.
